target_customer: Sales teams, asset managers and operations teams using CRMs
problem: CRM records go stale because reps do not enter data; DryMerge agents read email, calendar and calls and update the CRM.
business_model: B2B SaaS tiers with enterprise custom models
product_category: AI CRM updating and background agent platform

founders.name: Samuel Brashears
founders.background_notes: From the YC page, which lists only one founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable extraction from email and calls plus many CRM integrations; accuracy is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and custom field mappings add stickiness, but CRM vendors and AI native CRMs offer similar capture.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: CRM vendors and AI native CRMs such as Clarify added automatic capture by 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: Sales teams spend time on manual CRM entry and LLMs made extraction practical in 2023 and 2024.

identity.voice_and_tone: White glove and founder led support

brand_strength.rationale: TechCrunch, Business Insider and Black Enterprise covered the funding in September 2024, but there is no brand specific community or press.

pivots.from: no code chat to connect apps and automate API workflows
pivots.why: Early coverage (TechCrunch, 2024-09) described cross app automation; the site and YC page now center on CRM updating.

outcome_analysis: DryMerge raised a $2.2M seed in September 2024 after the Winter 2024 batch and refocused on CRM automation with customers such as Altai Capital and ContextLogic. Several rivals in AI CRM capture compete, and no later round or exit is known, so it is a small active company with modest verified traction.
notes: Seed seen across several outlets in search results (Black Enterprise, AI Insider, People of Color in Tech, UrbanGeekz, TechCrunch); I could not open the pages because of a rate limit, so details such as investors come from search snippets and the YC page confirms $2.2M. Databases show $2.5M to $2.7M total, unverified. Edward Frazer is named as a co-founder by press snippets but not on the YC page, so not listed. Competition: only 2026 comparison pages found, list empty. Name origin not found.
